Growth often happens outside of comfort zones, and you clearly prioritized your own well-being and autonomy. That said, the beauty of such decisions often reveals itself in hindsight. If I were in your shoes — valuing independence, needing a fresh start, and sensing that the timing was right — I’d hope I’d have the courage to do exactly what you did. Because sometimes, the most respectful thing we can do — for ourselves and, eventually, for our relationships — is to make hard choices with integrity, even if we make them alone.
